kappa_floor.note: Floor recorded before scoring. Chance-level kappa is a decoration; novelty may gate a stopping rule only when held-out kappa >= 0.40.

legacy_root.question: Question: does the runtime novelty score agree with human-labelled novelty, and by how much? Spec :11237 names duplicate ideas passing as novelty. Build a gold set of idea pairs labelled duplicate / variant / distinct, then report agreement (Cohen kappa) between the runtime score and the labels. A novelty score with kappa near chance is a decoration and must be demoted to advisory rather than allowed to gate a stopping rule.
legacy_root.residual_caveat: tools/council/simulate.py and a bucket-B07 production novelty scorer are absent on this worktree. The measured runtime is command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0266/novelty_runtime.py. This is a calibration of that scorer against a published gold set, not a claim that a production B07 scorer was imported. cloud ok=true is not delivery.

does_not_claim: a production B07 novelty scorer was imported from another unit
scope.proof_surface: held-out Cohen kappa on 30 pairs; adversarial load-bearing qualifier slice; seeded below-floor demotion of novelty from a stopping rule.

thresholds.note: Thresholds fitted on the tune half only; reported kappa is held-out.

legacy_root.title: Calibrate the novelty score against a labelled gold set instead of trusting the model that produced it

tune.note: Tune kappa is diagnostic only and is not the reported effect size.

kappa_floor.note: Floor recorded before scoring. Chance-level kappa is a decoration; novelty may gate a stopping rule only when held-out kappa >= 0.40.

question: Question: does the runtime novelty score agree with human-labelled novelty, and by how much? Spec :11237 names duplicate ideas passing as novelty. Build a gold set of idea pairs labelled duplicate / variant / distinct, then report agreement (Cohen kappa) between the runtime score and the labels. A novelty score with kappa near chance is a decoration and must be demoted to advisory rather than allowed to gate a stopping rule.
residual_caveat: tools/council/simulate.py and a bucket-B07 production novelty scorer are absent on this worktree. The measured runtime is command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0266/novelty_runtime.py. This is a calibration of that scorer against a published gold set, not a claim that a production B07 scorer was imported. cloud ok=true is not delivery.

does_not_claim: a production B07 novelty scorer was imported from another unit
scope.proof_surface: held-out Cohen kappa on 30 pairs; adversarial load-bearing qualifier slice; seeded below-floor demotion of novelty from a stopping rule.
